condition: Requires a runway-specific approved safety assessment and procedure published in AIP/local instructions. Daylight only: 30 min after sunrise through 30 min before sunset. Apply wake minima. Visibility >=5 km; ceiling >=300 m; tailwind <=5 kt; controller has suitable landmarks or approved surveillance; departure gap must remain at/above minimum immediately after second take-off; succeeding crew gets traffic information; braking not adversely affected by ice/slush/snow/water. Landing: Cat 1 follower after Cat 1/2 leader at >=600 m from threshold and moving to vacate without backtracking, or airborne beyond 600 m; Cat 2 follower after Cat 1/2 leader at >=1500 m and moving to vacate without backtracking, or airborne beyond 1500 m; any follower after Cat 3 leader at >=2400 m and moving to vacate without backtracking, or airborne beyond 2400 m. Departure: Cat 1 follower after Cat 1/2 leader airborne and >=600 m beyond follower position; Cat 2 follower after Cat 1/2 leader airborne and >=1500 m beyond follower position; any follower after Cat 3 leader airborne and >=2400 m beyond follower position.
minimum: Landing: Cat 1 600; Cat 2 1500; Cat 3 2400. Departure: Cat 1 600; Cat 2 1500; Cat 3 2400
